entries.body:
Summary of work so far (stages 1-2 of 3 read; stage 3 not yet released):

Stage 1 facts (paths relative to /task/fixtures):
- stage-1/UPDATE.md:1-3. Window 08:00-09:30 UTC. ingress-a began returning 5xx for payments-api shortly after a deploy.
- stage-1/deploy/deploys.log:1. 2031-03-06T08:14:28Z, payments-api build 6.25.3-646f (previous 6.24.1) rolled out 100%. Lines 2-7 are deploys of other services and look irrelevant.
- stage-1/config/payments-api.yaml (repo values, superseded): line 7 tax-engine timeout_ms 2500; line 11 database.pool.max_size 48; line 12 acquire_timeout_ms 5000.
- stage-1/deploy/release-notes-6.25.3-646f.md:
  - line 5: timeout_ms changed 2500 to 800.
  - line 17: db.pool.max_size changed 48 to 10, "to fit the shared-db connection quota".
- stage-1/logs/ingress-a.log:80. First 503 at 08:16:11 with "upstream timeout".
- stage-1/logs/payments-api.log: tax-engine "timed out after 800ms" from line 153 onward. Pool waits (in_use 10/10) appeared only 7 times (line 175, line 204).

Stage 2 facts (09:30-10:30):
- stage-2/UPDATE.md:3-4. The mitigation stopped the tax-engine timeouts, but 503s continue with a different error.
- stage-2/deploy/changes.log:
  - line 1: 09:35:24Z CHG-5266 APPLIED, tax-engine timeout_ms=4000 (was 800). Timeout is now resolved; current value 4000.
  - line 2: CHG-5267 PROPOSED for catalog-api; not applied, irrelevant.
  - line 3: CHG-5268 for shipping-api log level; irrelevant.
- stage-2/ops/oncall-notes.md:6. On-call suspects db pool exhaustion but wrongly cites yaml max_size 48. The effective value is 10, per release notes line 17.
- stage-2/logs/payments-api.log: "db pool exhausted: N/N connections in use, waited Nms (acquire_timeout)" appears about 110 times, first at line 136-137 and line 162. The rest is noise (gc, dns retry ok, tls expiry warnings, disk usage).
- stage-2/logs/ingress-a.log:53. 09:38:41 status=503 with "upstream returned 503".
- stage-2/metrics/payments-api.csv: db_pool_in_use is pinned at 10 from line 15 (09:43) through line 60 (10:28). p99_ms ranges 3391-5117 (line 2 at 09:30: in_use 9).

Current hypothesis: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED. Pool max_size is 10, set by stage-1/deploy/release-notes-6.25.3-646f.md:17, with no APPLIED override yet. Remedy would be RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT (e.g., back to 48, within the shared-db quota).
- CLIENT_TIMEOUT_TOO_LOW is superseded by CHG-5266.

Next steps:
- Advance to stage 3 and read all files.
- Check for any APPLIED change to pool max_size; a later APPLIED record would win and become required_value and evidence ref (2).
- Confirm the symptom persists.
- Planned evidence refs:
  - (1) symptom: stage-2 (or stage-3) payments-api.log pool-exhausted lines plus metrics.
  - (2) current-value record: release-notes:17, unless overridden in stage 3.
  - (3) originating change: release-notes:17.

[step 6] execute
